options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path of a terraform binary to use.

options.name: format
options.description: A flag to specify the output format. Defaults to C(json). I(name) must be provided when using C(raw) option.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of an individual output in the state file to list.

options.name: project_path
options.description: The path to the root of the Terraform directory with the terraform.tfstate file. If I(state_file) and I(project_path) are not specified, the C(terraform.tfstate) file in the current working directory will be used. The C(TF_DATA_DIR) environment variable is respected.

options.name: state_file
options.description: The path to an existing Terraform state file whose outputs will be listed. If I(state_file) and I(project_path) are not specified, the C(terraform.tfstate) file in the current working directory will be used. The C(TF_DATA_DIR) environment variable is respected. This option is not compatible for remote states.

options.name: workspace
options.description: The terraform workspace to work with.
